profile.headline: Data Engineer and Analytics Developer
profile.summary:
Data, analytics, and process engineer.  Working in the government administration industry in data analytics and data warehousing.  Expertise and certification in agile and lean development, processing, and deployments.  Skilled in Government, Fraud Detection, Fraud Investigations, Policy Analysis, and Fraud Prevention. Business development professional with a Master of Public Administration - MPA focused in Oversight, Inspection, Audits, and Investigations from John Jay College (CUNY). 

If you want to go fast, go alone.  If you want to go far, go together.
